SELECT po.po_no, po.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, po.operator_id, u.real_name AS operator_name, po.order_date, po.delivery_place, po.status, po.remark, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(pi.quantity * pi.unit_price * pi.discount, 2)), 0) FROM purchase_item pi WHERE pi.po_no = po.po_no) AS total_amount FROM purchase_order po LEFT JOIN supplier s ON po.supplier_id = s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON po.operator_id = u.user_id
ORDER BY po.po_no DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO purchase_order (po_no, supplier_id, operator_id, order_date, delivery_place, status, remark) VALUES (#{poNo}, #{supplierId}, #{operatorId}, #{orderDate}, #{deliveryPlace}, #{status}, #{remark})
